populations.purpose: Stable document-grounded retrieval, authority, factual, and citation baseline for static technical questions.
populations.reuse_policy: After qualification access, reuse for regression only; never refresh qualification claims from a consumed partition.

populations.purpose: Evaluate the same facts across terse, conversational, ambiguous, frustrated, follow-up, explanation, customer-ready, unknown, and handoff contexts.
populations.reuse_policy: Development examples may be iterated; validation freezes prompt decisions; qualification remains untouched until one governed run.

populations.purpose: Measure retrieval and answer degradation under distractors, revisions, duplicate documents, noisy extraction, and scale.
populations.reuse_policy: Stable subset may compare CORPUS_A/B/C; consumed qualification cases remain regression-only.

populations.purpose: Evaluate current price, promotion, inventory, product state, shipping, order, return, and warranty/workflow facts.
populations.reuse_policy: Fixture definitions may be reused; qualification instances require frozen unexposed state assignments and exact timestamps.

populations.purpose: Evaluate questions requiring two or more fact-type authority classes in one response.
populations.reuse_policy: Atomic fact ledgers and source snapshots must remain bound; consumed qualification cases become regression-only.

populations.purpose: Evaluate high-consequence ambiguity, misleading identifiers, unsafe selection, contradiction, and temptation to guess.
populations.reuse_policy: After exposure, use only for regression and known-defect coverage; create fresh protected cases for qualification.

populations.purpose: Observe real internal questions, failure strata, and usefulness in non-authoritative shadow mode.
populations.reuse_policy: No automatic gold; sample under approved privacy/retention controls for separate adjudication and future benchmark design.

populations.purpose: Small deterministic known-defect set for fast local and CI regression checks.
populations.reuse_policy: May be rerun for regression indefinitely but never used to claim generalized accuracy or fresh qualification.
